product: Albemarle produces lithium in Energy Storage (spodumene, lithium carbonate and hydroxide) and Specialties (bromine, lithium specialties, catalysts). It sold a 51% stake in Ketjen's refining catalyst solutions business on 2026-03-02, retaining Performance Catalyst Solutions.
demand: Management cites resilient demand across energy storage, EVs and semiconductors, with FY2026 Energy Storage sales volume guided to 225-235 kt LCE and Specialties net sales raised to $1.4-1.6B. Specialties end markets show modest growth, offset by expected softness in automotive and petrochemicals.
pricing_power: Pricing power is cyclical, not structural: realized lithium price rose to $19.53/kg in Q2 2026 from $12.17/kg a year earlier, driven by market indices rather than contracts. Guidance assumes flat market pricing, and only about one-third of total volumes are locked on long-term agreements.
competition: Competes with SQM, Pilbara Minerals, Ganfeng, Tianqi and other lithium producers, plus bromine and catalyst peers. Albemarle claims industry-leading resources and conversion network and a low-cost position, but spot-linked pricing means it is largely a price-taker in Energy Storage.
team: Chairman and CEO Kent Masters moves to Executive Chairman when Ragnar Udd, currently BHP Chief Commercial Officer, becomes CEO on 2027-02-01; Gerald Steiner remains Lead Independent Director. The board added ex-Vale CEO Eduardo Bartolomeo on 2026-07-23, and several officer changes were filed in 2026 8-Ks.
market_strategy: Strategy centers on disciplined capital allocation and cost and productivity improvement ($100M year to date, targeting $100-150M for 2026), cutting capex to about $500M, deleveraging to roughly 0.5x net debt to EBITDA, and prioritizing highest-value organic growth in Energy Storage and Specialties.
bull: Q2 2026 net sales $1.74B up 31% and adjusted EBITDA $858M up 155%, with Energy Storage realized price $19.53/kg up 60%; FY2026 EBITDA guided $2.4-2.6B if lithium holds near $20/kg, and net debt/EBITDA near 0.5x.
bear: Shares fell ~28% in 63 days despite record Q2; 90-day analyst actions netted ~12 target cuts across 11 firms (Mizuho, JPMorgan to $140; Weiss to Sell). Guidance falls to $0.9-1.0B EBITDA if lithium stays near $10/kg, and 2027 EPS is forecast to fall.
falsifier: If lithium prices hold near the Q1 2026 average of about $20/kg, FY2026 adjusted EBITDA should land at $2.4-2.6B; a reported FY2026 adjusted EBITDA below $1.5B would prove the bull case wrong.
web_what_changed: Q2 2026 results on 2026-08-05: net sales $1.74B up 31%, adjusted EBITDA $858M up 155%, Energy Storage realized price $19.53/kg up 60%, net income $480M. CEO succession on 2026-09-03 named BHP commercial chief Ragnar Udd CEO from 2027-02-01, Kent Masters to Executive Chairman. Board added ex-Vale CEO Eduardo Bartolomeo 2026-07-23. Talison CGP3 fire 2026-06-09. Shares fell about 28% in 63 days.
web_not_known_yesterday: not found. No disclosure dated 2026-09-24 or 2026-09-25 was located on Albemarle's investor site or SEC EDGAR. The latest dated items remain the 2026-09-03 CEO succession 8-K and the 2026-09-18 Mizuho target cut. Shares closed 2026-09-24 at $108.25, down 4.6% that day.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Price-led. Energy Storage Q2 2026 realized price rose 60.5% to $19.53/kg LCE while volume rose 11% to 65 kt LCE; Specialties price rose 11% and volume 8%. Guidance assumes flat market pricing flowing through the contract book, so near-term growth is lithium price plus modest volume, not mix.
web_suppliers: Key inputs: spodumene from the Talison Lithium JV (Greenbushes) and the Wodgina mine, Chilean brine under CORFO leases, and bromine via the Jordan Bromine Company JV. Constraints are real: the Talison CGP3 fire on 2026-06-09 delayed the ramp, partly offset by Wodgina, and higher CORFO commissions raised Energy Storage costs.
web_customers: Sells into the battery and EV energy-storage chain plus Specialties end markets including semiconductors, oil and gas, flame retardants, pharmaceuticals and automotive. Albemarle states roughly 40% of salts volume, about one-third of total volumes, is on long-term agreements. No single-customer concentration figure was found in the sources read.
web_who_loses: Competing lithium suppliers lose share and pricing power if Albemarle wins: SQM, Pilbara Minerals, Ganfeng, Tianqi and other brine and spodumene producers. Battery-cell and automaker customers lose if higher lithium prices stick, and sodium-ion substitute developers lose relevance if lithium stays cheap. Talison JV partner Tianqi shares the outcome.
web_contradicting_evidence: Shares fell about 28% in 63 days despite record Q2, and last-90-day analyst actions netted about 12 target cuts across 11 firms, with Mizuho and JPMorgan cutting to $140 and Weiss downgrading to Sell. Guidance shows adjusted EBITDA of only $0.9-1.0B if lithium stays near $10/kg versus $2.4-2.6B at $20/kg; 2027 EPS is forecast to fall.
web_if_management_right: If lithium prices hold near the Q1 2026 average of about $20/kg, FY2026 adjusted EBITDA lands at $2.4-2.6B, net debt to EBITDA stays near 0.5x, free cash flow supports the dividend, capital spending holds near $500M, and incoming CEO Udd inherits a deleveraged platform for contract and growth strategy.
web_if_management_wrong: If lithium stays near $10/kg, corporate adjusted EBITDA collapses to $0.9-1.0B and Energy Storage EBITDA to $0.7-0.8B, versus consensus net income of about $1.2B and $11.56 EPS that assume recovery. Contract renegotiation pressure, CORFO and Talison cost escalation and JV equity-income erosion hit first, weakening the new CEO.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Talison JV partner Tianqi Lithium and Wodgina/MARBL partner Mineral Resources gain from higher spodumene volumes, and CORFO collects higher Chilean commissions. Conversion tollers, lithium equipment and reagent suppliers and bromine/flame-retardant peers benefit. Cheaper or steadier lithium helps cell and EV makers, while sustained high prices help sodium-ion and recycling developers.
